evidence: src/infrastructure/in-memory-product-repository.ts: class InMemoryProductRepository implements ProductRepository and stores products in a private Map<string, Product>, which is a persistence-adapter responsibility of the infrastructure layer.
findByIds removes duplicate ids with new Set(ids) and leaves out missing products. This is data lookup, not a business rule.
findAll and save are plain storage operations, and the class contains no domain invariants or application orchestration.

Nothing in it carries pricing, validation, policy or other domain or application logic.
